role: Marker interface for hostile, player-attacking mobs; consumed by the mob-selector used in spawn rules, EntityAITarget and the IMob-aware entity helpers.

members.name: mobSelector
members.note: the isAssignableFrom check folds into a kind-range test over the hostile kinds (survival.c:392's comment names the EntityGiantZombie hole)

notes: The Java selector includes EntityGiantZombie via instanceof; the native kind-range test covers exactly the hostile kinds, which is the same set on the probe since the giant is never spawned.
